description:
Copy an existing web page as native sections (clone_page), or read a page's text/images as a blueprint (ingest_*). Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- clone_page: Clone a web page into NATIVE sections (text/image/button/form/video/container rows — no embed, no custom code).
- get_clone_script: Get the capture script for clone_page: run it inside the source page with YOUR browser tool when clone_page can't open the page itself (remote server, no local Chrome, a page be…
- ingest_url: Fetch a public URL and parse it into a structural blueprint (see ingest_html).
- ingest_html: For a faithful copy of a live page use clone_page (native sections from the rendered layout).

help.description: Return the action's full documentation and argument schema instead of running it

rehost_images.description: Upload images (and svg icons as PNG) to the WebCake CDN (default false) [clone_page]

skip_chrome.description: Leave out the source's header/footer/nav (use the site's global ones). [clone_page]

snapshot.description: Result of the get_clone_script script (object or JSON string), instead of url [clone_page]

name: clone
